content:

TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here!
Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration?
Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project! Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome!
JOB DETAILS
Company: Turing
Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
Location: Fully Remote

Project Duration: 10–12 weeks
Commitment: 20–40 hours/week

REQUIRED SKILLS
Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop
Digital Illustration & Sketching
Character Design & Cartooning
Composition, Color & Perspective
Creativity & Attention to Detail

Strong art portfolio showcasing your skills
Experience with Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools
Ability to maintain character consistency across different styles
Familiarity with surreal, cinematic, retro, steampunk, or other visual styles is a plus

Create high-quality character illustrations from references.
Develop creative variations while preserving character identity.
Adapt artwork to different artistic styles.
Refine designs based on project feedback.
Document creative choices and submit polished artwork.

trabaheroph@gmail.com

title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
content:
HIRING!
Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
Fully Remote
https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm
Role Overview
We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity.
This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.
What You’ll Do
1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images.
2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency.
3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion.
4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements.
5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata.
6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.
